description: This file defines the DSNConfigurator class, responsible for parsing Data Source Name (DSN) strings and configuring PHPMailer instances accordingly. It includes methods for interpreting DSN URLs, setting SMTP options, and applying various configuration parameters to PHPMailer objects.

classes.name: DSNConfigurator
classes.description: A class to parse DSN strings and configure PHPMailer instances based on those DSNs.

methods.name: mailer
methods.description: Creates and configures a PHPMailer instance based on a given DSN string.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures a provided PHPMailer instance with settings parsed from a DSN string.

methods.name: parseDSN
methods.description: Parses a DSN string into configuration components, including scheme, host, port, and query parameters.

methods.name: applyConfig
methods.description: Applies the parsed configuration to a PHPMailer instance, including setting mailer type and SMTP options.

methods.name: configureSMTP
methods.description: Sets SMTP-specific options on a PHPMailer instance based on the DSN configuration.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets additional options on a PHPMailer instance from a provided options array.

methods.name: parseUrl
methods.description: A wrapper around PHP's parse_url to work around specific PHP version bugs.
